title: FBI-UAP-D041, Digital Rendering 1, “Multiple Red Lights,” 2026
doc_notes: This document is a collection of digital renderings created by the FBI in 2026 as visual aids for the PURSUE initiative, based on descriptions from a separate report (FBI-UAP-D040).

incidents.summary: A series of digital renderings depicting an increasing number of red light clusters in triangular formations over a desert mountain range.
incidents.quote: small, bright cluster of three red lights arranged in a triangular formation
